chars.S: SOHAIB: a young man wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie, black jogger trousers, white sneakers and a small black backpack.
chars.K: KHAWLA: a young woman wearing a long lilac trench coat over a white top, light blue jeans, white sneakers and a small red handbag.
chars.R: the RECEPTIONIST: a chubby middle-aged man wearing a dark green traditional Moroccan djellaba, a red fez hat and a thin black moustache.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Casablanca apartment living room, KHAWLA holds a phone to her ear smiling innocently and lying to her mother, while SOHAIB stands right next to her holding two suitcases with a finger on his lips making a shush gesture, both looking nervous and cheeky. Funny secret mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SOHAIB and KHAWLA walk excitedly with rolling suitcases through a narrow orange-walled alley of the Marrakech old medina towards a big carved wooden riad door, happy and giddy.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a luxurious traditional Marrakech riad courtyard with a turquoise pool, zellige tiles, arches and orange trees, SOHAIB and KHAWLA stand side by side with their mouths open in amazement.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SOHAIB alone touches the colorful zellige mosaic wall of the riad with wide amazed eyes, a carved plaster arch above him, warm afternoon light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: At the small wooden reception desk of the riad, the RECEPTIONIST hands one single old brass key to SOHAIB with a sly knowing smile, KHAWLA stands slightly behind SOHAIB looking shy and avoiding his gaze.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At night on the riad rooftop terrace with lanterns and the lights of Marrakech and the Koutoubia minaret in the distance, SOHAIB and KHAWLA sit close together drinking mint tea and laughing happily.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the morning SOHAIB sits alone relaxed on a traditional Moroccan sofa in the riad salon with a coffee cup, smiling and calm, cushions and brass lamps around.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The RECEPTIONIST walks up to SOHAIB who is sitting on the sofa with his coffee, bending toward him with a suspicious sly grin, rubbing his hands together; SOHAIB looks up surprised.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close shot: the RECEPTIONIST leans very close to SOHAIB and whispers with narrowed eyes and a threatening smile, SOHAIB freezes in shock and spills his coffee, sweat drops on his head.
